# Importing and Merging Data

```{r import}

#In this chunk we are importing data 

#set working directory
#setwd("C:/Users/igrossma/Dropbox/Community 1.0 Raw Files/CSV")

#setwd("C:/Users/mypc/Dropbox/Community 1.0 Raw Files/Clean Code for OSF")

#import main dataset
diary.social.roles<-read.csv("SocialRoles_coded.condition.csv")






```


```{r test.model}

#center condition
diary.social.roles$Condition.C <- scale(diary.social.roles$Condition, scale=FALSE)

#Build model
model.social.roles<-glmer(Explicit.role ~ Condition.C+(1|subjectNumber),data=diary.social.roles, family=binomial)

#check model summary
summ(model.social.roles, digits = 4, center = TRUE) #No difference between conditions

#Check model summary using the Anova function from the car package
car::Anova(model.social.roles, type = "III")

```
